Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not have my name in it, but you can refer to me as the claimant.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in League City, Texas, making a left turn at an intersection with a traffic signal.
Q: What was the signal showing when you started the turn?
A: It had turned yellow, and I was already in the middle of the intersection, so I completed the turn.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?
A: Not clearly. I saw headlights coming from the opposite direction, but I assumed the driver would stop.
Q: How fast were you going?
A: Prboably around twenty-five miles per hour. I was slowing for the light.
Q: Where did the impact occur on your vehicle?
A: On the driver's side front, near the wheel well.
Q: Did you feel any injuries right after the collision?
A: My lower back was stiff, but I didn't think much of it at first. By the next morning it was sharp and I had trouble
bending.
Q: Have you sought medical care since then?
A: Yes, I was seen at an urgent care clinic and was told I had a back strain. I've been doing physcial therapy twice a
week.
Q: Did you have any back problems before this collision?
A: I had some minor soreness now and then from lifting at work, but nothing that stopped me from working or needed
treatment.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I'm still having pain when I sit for long periods, and I'm following my doctor's instructions.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>
